name: WizardOS 0.3.134 — 0.3.102 with Troubleshooter 3e56f66d -> 9088a254 (self-sufficient recovery)
about: Stable 0.3.102 with only the Troubleshooter pin moved, 3e56f66d -> 9088a254 (humanitylabs-org/wizard-troubleshooter main, #24-#42): the Troubleshooter gets a locked-out box back on its own: a bounded forced Hermes restart when a drain hangs, Restart now, crash-loop handoff, the reply keeper check, owner-approved repair plans on by default, and the page watches itself. Every other pin is exactly 0.3.102. Cut for Stable so fresh installs get it; Latest gets the same pin in the next release.

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.

wizard-app-manager.note: Official main at 525e9d3d (merge of #408: app update writes WIZARD_OWNER_LOGINS for recipes that declare it, including the flag-first and bulk update forms). Between the previous pin 23a71b5d and this commit main also merged #371, #373, #375, #383, #385, #388, #389, #392, #393, #398, #401, #402 and the 0.3.92-0.3.101 release mirrors.

wizard-troubleshooter.note: Host tooling, no image: installed by `wam troubleshooter` as user systemd units (wizard-troubleshooter.service + wizard-guardian.timer, report-only) from exactly this commit; main 9088a25 = 3e56f66 plus #24 (Agent Service repaired through App Manager), #25 (James's one-tap repair screen restored), #26 (the guardian only undoes an update when the link was healthy before it), #29 (the guardian heals app addresses), #34 (busy is not down; a restart that didn't hold is not repeated), #35 (HEAD answers so the shell opens the real Troubleshooter), #36/#38 (owner-approved repair plans with backups and Undo), #39 (replies that never start are an incident; owner can restart Hermes while it looks green), #40 (WizardOS spelling), #41 (an approved Hermes restart actually runs; a draining restart is reported as in progress), #42 (bounded Hermes restart: the drain stops waiting and the gateway is restarted, Restart now, crash-loop handoff, reply keeper check, repair plans on by default, the page watches itself, no Telegram/console advice). The guardian stays report-only (GUARDIAN_ACT=0) as before.
